mapper.insert: insert into score (student_id, course_id, score) values (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{score})
mapper.delete: delete from score where student_id = #{studentId} and course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: select s.id, s.student_id as studentId, s.course_id as courseId, s.score, c.course_name as courseName, c.credit, u.real_name as teacherName from score s inner join course c on s.course_id = c.id left join `user` u on c.teacher_id = u.id where s.student_id = #{studentId} order by c.id
